result.title: RankFormer: Rethinking Time Series Transformers through Representation Capacity Analysis and Progressive Decoding
result.summary: Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in Web and cyber-physical systems, where large-scale services and IoT infrastructures generate complex temporal data. Transformer-based models have achieved strong empirical performance in this domain, yet the principles governing the expressive capacity of their learned representations remain insufficiently understood. Moreover, many existing models rely on simplified decoding strategies, including channel-independent modeling and direct projection heads, which limit their ability to capture complex multivariate dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose RankFormer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture for multivariate time series forecasting. We establish a rank-based analysis framework to investigate how tokenization, embedding, and attention designs affect the representation capacity of time series Transformers. Our analysis reveals that patchification increases the potential representation capacity by aggregating multiple temporal observations into each token, while subsequent encoding operations determine how much of this capacity is realized. Guided by these insights, we develop a rank-enhancing encoder with Hourglass Attention to improve rank stability during information interaction. Furthermore, we introduce the Interactive Progressive Decoder (IPD), which improves future trajectory modeling through global-guided cross-channel interaction and progressive refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world long-term forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that RankFormer achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods. Code repository: https://github.com/TangPeiwang/Rankformer.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RankFormer 多变量时序预测模型，建立基于秩的分析框架，考察 tokenization、嵌入与注意力设计如何影响时序 Transformer 的表示容量，并据此设计带 Hourglass Attention 的秩增强编码器和交互式渐进解码器（IPD）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「patchification 提升潜在容量、后续编码决定实际实现多少」的秩容量视角，可能为核查 latent 推理状态的信息坍缩与有效容量提供分析工具，渐进式解码也可能对 latent 状态迭代更新有借鉴，但需核查其是否依赖时序通道结构。
